turns.prompt: Compare Card, Surface and Modal for me: what each is for, and when to reach for it.

replies.text:
**Reach for Card to group one item's content, Surface for a plain raised area, and Modal when the task has to interrupt the page.**

| Component | What it's for | Reach for it when |
|---|---|---|
| Card | one item's content, framed | a list or grid of similar things |
| Surface | a background layer | you need elevation with no structure |
| Modal | a focused task over the page | the person must finish or cancel first |

That's from the design-system docs I know, not a fresh read, so check Storybook before you build on the edge cases.
